== Title ==
<span lang="ja">この寒さではスピーダーが動きません</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して場の自分の側に配備する。“夜間状態”のマーカー位置にいる乗用生物以外のビークルはすべて戦闘力＝0、回避値＝0、移動速度＝0となる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「まだ低温対策が万全ではないのです」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Too Cold For Speeders.

'''Lore''' — Cold-weather countermeasures are not yet complete.

'''Game text''' — Spend 2 Force to deploy on your side of the table. All non-creature vehicles at marker locations under nighttime conditions have power, maneuver, and landspeed of 0.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The title is translated. Lore is a different quote about incomplete cold countermeasures. Game text spends 2 Force and uses 位置 for marker sites.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-toocoldforspeeders.gif|Original English face]], [[Too Cold For Speeders]].</ref>
